page: Microsoft Azure M64lds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor featuring 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and a total of 1024.0 GB of system memory. With a memory-to-vCPU allocation of 16.0 GB per virtual core, the architecture provides substantial memory density designed to serve memory-intensive enterprise software.

Storage capabilities include 2362 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. This bundled NVMe disk provides fast temporary data handling, local caching, and scratch space without incurring latency across network attachments. The instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not incorporate dedicated GPU hardware, concentrating resources strictly on general compute and memory throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high ratio of 16.0 GB RAM per vCPU and dedicated core assignment avoid resource fragmentation and reduce virtualization contention for large data sets. The inclusion of high-capacity local NVMe storage also eliminates the need to provision external high-IOPS storage solely for transient operational files. The instance is structurally aligned with large-scale relational database engines, in-memory databases, real-time caching tiers, and analytical data transformation pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure M64lds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance designed for large-scale enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory density. Configured with an x86_64 Intel processor running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the server provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 1024.0 GB of memory, delivering a ratio of 16.0 GB per virtual core. The instance includes 2362 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and support for Premium Storage, offering fast ephemeral data access for temporary files, swap space, and high-throughput caching. The platform does not incorporate hardware graphics accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By consolidating dedicated compute resources, a large RAM footprint, and fast local NVMe capacity, the M64lds_v4 instance avoids memory-bound processing bottlenecks. It is suitable for large in-memory databases, relational database management systems, big data processing frameworks, and heavy analytical data pipelines.
